meta.title: AgriLens AI · Your AI-powered crop health assistant
meta.description: Instant expert advice on crop diseases, pests, soil health and farm management, in your language.

landing.eyebrow: A crop doctor in your pocket
landing.title: See what your <accent>crops</accent> are telling you
landing.subtitle: Snap a leaf, ask a question, get a clear diagnosis and a treatment plan in seconds. Built for growers, in your language.
landing.trust: Free to start · Works on any phone · 10 languages

scan.alt: A farmer checking corn crop health with AgriLens AI

features.title: Everything you need, right in the field
features.subtitle: One assistant that sees, listens, and speaks your language.

diagnosis.title: Image diagnosis
diagnosis.body: Photograph a leaf and AgriLens marks the problem, rates the severity and tells you how confident it is.

streaming.title: Answers as they form
streaming.body: Advice streams in word by word, so you start reading straight away, even on a slow connection.

voice.title: Talk, don't type
voice.body: Ask out loud and have answers read back to you. Your hands stay free for the work.

languages.title: 10 languages
languages.body: Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Swahili, Spanish, Portuguese and English.

weather.title: Weather-aware advice
weather.body: Spray windows and disease risk that account for the rain and humidity on your farm.

map.title: Farm map
map.body: Pin your fields and see which plots need attention at a glance.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: Install it like an app. Past answers stay available when the signal drops.

how.title: From field to fix in three steps

snap.title: Snap or ask
snap.body: Take a photo of the affected plant or describe what you see.

read.title: Get a diagnosis
read.body: See the likely cause, how severe it is, and how sure we are.

act.title: Act with confidence
act.body: Follow clear steps for treatment now and prevention next season.
